verdicts.explanation: The paper states the Li PGE (PVdF-HFP with LiClO4 in EC:PC) has conductivity 0.03 mS/cm and pH 5 at 25 oC, measured by the authors in the Experimental section, so value, unit, temperature, origin and synthesis all match. Scope is borderline because this is a liquid-plasticized gel rather than a dry solid, but the paper itself calls it a polymer gel electrolyte and the reported values are correct.
